“但让我告诉你，当你面对痛苦的悲剧时，很容易失去信念。”

segments.body:
It's easy to give in to pain and let go of hope.
“很容易向痛苦屈服，放弃希望。”

segments.body:
I learned this firsthand when Natalie disappeared.
“娜塔莉失踪时，我亲身体会到了这一点。”
segments.text:

segments.body:
I've learned a lot of things about hope since then.
“从那以后，我学到了很多关于希望的事情。”
